List → Regex

Convert any list of strings into a regex pattern with automatic escaping and deduplication.

Stays in your browser
0 values
0 characters

How it works: With Exact match enabled, the output looks like ^(value1|value2)$, meaning the entire field must match exactly. Without it, the pattern is (value1|value2) for substring matching. Regex special characters are escaped automatically.
